futurecasts.author: Ray Kurzweil
futurecasts.condition: We'll have very high bandwidth wireless internet woven in our clothing.

futurecasts.author: Ray Kurzweil
futurecasts.condition: Personal computers will have the computational capacity of the human brain.

futurecasts.author: Ray Kurzweil
futurecasts.condition: A $1,000 computer will match the processing power of the human brain.
futurecasts.notes: From The Age of Spiritual Machines (1999)

futurecasts.author: Elon Musk
futurecasts.condition: Self-driving cars will be ubiquitous; human driving will be illegal on highways.

futurecasts.author: Clifford Stoll
futurecasts.condition: The internet will collapse under its own weight and become irrelevant.

futurecasts.author: Andrew Ng
futurecasts.condition: AI will be able to perform most white-collar cognitive tasks as well as humans.
futurecasts.notes: Approximate paraphrase from public talks, c. 2017

futurecasts.author: Marvin Minsky
futurecasts.condition: Within a generation the problem of creating artificial intelligence will be substantially solved.

futurecasts.author: Geoffrey Hinton
futurecasts.condition: Deep learning will replace radiologists within five years.

futurecasts.author: Peter Diamandis
futurecasts.condition: Solar power will meet 100% of the world's energy needs.

futurecasts.author: Marc Andreessen
futurecasts.condition: Software will eat the world; most traditional industries will be software companies.

futurecasts.author: Sam Altman
futurecasts.condition: AGI will be developed within the next decade.
futurecasts.notes: Placeholder — approximate paraphrase from various interviews
